limits: Ten pinned OS/test/tooling inputs and inert synthetic wheel payloads only. The CLI never imports candidate code, installs packages, resolves versions or adds the candidate wheelhouse to sys.path.

The exact packaging snapshot executes as host build tooling from a private exclusive read-back copy. Its namespace, temporary copy and zip caches are removed even on exceptions and interruptions; ambient packaging is refused.

Tests cover fixed-point extras through cycles and order changes, transitive extras, missing or superfluous distributions, all active version constraints, explicit prerelease admission, metadata identity, Python compatibility, inactive URLs, bounded AST marker checks, quotes and forbidden kernel/host variables.
The marker target is fixed CPython 3.13.5 on aarch64 Linux. Kernel release/version marker references are refused; no host default_environment participates.
The minimal hosted CLI fixture uses these same ten inputs. Linux root tests do not establish a complete production build, candidate ABI or runtime environment.
The macOS full suite runs under umask 077 with 15 platform skips. All 33 dependency fixture cases have no skip on either host.
Actual Studio input metadata verification, native loader closure, privacy/provenance/license audits, support, service graph, image, first boot and hardware qualification remain separate.
